name: Sales & Business Development
description: A results-first home page with quota and pipeline figures, closed deals and client names for sales, account and business development professionals.
guidance: Only publish figures and client names you are allowed to share. Check your employer and customer agreements, round or index confidential revenue and quota numbers, and ask permission before naming a client or a deal.

heroSuggestions.title: Sales and Business Development Lead
heroSuggestions.summary: Sales and business development lead who builds pipeline and closes complex deals, consistently beating quota through careful discovery, clear proposals and long-term client relationships.

seo.title: {name} — {title}
seo.description: {name}, {title}. Quota results, closed deals and how to get in touch.
seo.aboutDescription: About {name}, {title}: the approach, the deals and relationships behind the numbers, and the teams worked with.

summary.hint: The territory or accounts you owned and the result you delivered.

highlights.label: Key results
highlights.hint: One per line, up to 12. Lead with the figure, such as quota attainment.

title.hint: Name the deal, for example the client and what was sold.

role.hint: Your part, for example Account executive or Deal lead.

org.label: Client
org.hint: Shown on the card and in the client strip on the home page. Only name a client you have permission to name.

problem.label: The situation
problem.hint: The client's need and what was at stake. Plain text.

approach.label: How it was won
approach.hint: Discovery, who was involved, the proposal and the close. Plain text.

impact.label: Results
impact.hint: One result per line, up to 8. Start with the figure, such as "132% of quota", so it is shown large; the first line is shown on the card. Use figures you can share.

heroImage.label: Cover image
heroImage.hint: Shown on the deals grid and at the top of the deal page. JPEG, PNG or WebP. Cropped to a 3:2 card.

screenshots.label: Supporting images
screenshots.hint: Add pictures one at a time on the Images page, such as a proposal page or a chart. Each needs a description for people who cannot see it.

links.label: Links
links.hint: Where to see more, such as a public case study or announcement. Videos are linked, never embedded.

category.hint: A segment such as Enterprise, Mid-market or Partnerships. Used by the filter on the deals page.

credentialUrl.label: Link to the award or course

url.label: Link to the recording or slides
url.hint: http or https. Recordings are linked, not embedded.

quote.label: What they said
quote.hint: Plain text. Only with the person's permission.

body.label: Insight text
body.hint: Markdown. Raw HTML is shown as text, not run.

cover.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Shown at the top of the post and when it is shared.

heading.label: Home page introduction
heading.hint: The first thing visitors read, above your headline figures. Plain text. Changes apply as soon as you save.

eyebrow.label: Role line
eyebrow.hint: For example your market and the kind of deals you close. Plain text.

heading.label: Headline figures
heading.hint: The big numbers at the top of your home page, such as quota attainment, revenue closed or win rate. Only publish figures you can share. Changes apply as soon as you save.

unit.hint: For example of quota or closed-won.

heading.label: Pages of your site
heading.hint: Choose which pages the site has, what the menu calls them and in which order. Hiding a page never deletes it. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: About you
heading.hint: Your story, how you work and what you care about. Changes apply as soon as you save.

valueProps.label: Principles
valueProps.hint: Short statements about how you work, shown above the text.

heading.label: Back up and restore your portfolio
heading.hint: Keep your portfolio in one file, or restore one. You see what would change first, and nothing is ever removed.

exportHeading.label: Save a copy
exportHeading.hint: One file with your details and every entry, including unpublished ones. Pictures you uploaded are listed, not included.

importHeading.label: Restore from a file
importHeading.hint: Each entry in the file is matched to one of yours by its name or title: a match is updated, anything else is added.

layout.footerNote: Sales and business development portfolio. Figures and clients are shared with permission.

home.workEmptyBody: Add the deals you are proudest of. Lead with the outcome, then explain how you won it.
home.contactHeading: Looking for a closer? Let us talk.

projects.title: Deals & results
projects.description: Closed deals, each with the situation, how it was won and the measured result.
projects.heading: Deals and results
projects.lead: Each deal leads with the outcome: the situation, how I won it and what it was worth.
projects.emptyBody: Add your first deal with the client, the situation and the result it delivered.
projects.noWriteup: The full story of this deal is on the way.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: {name}'s sales experience: teams, territories and quota results, most recent first.
experience.heading: Where I have sold
experience.lead: Most recent first: the teams I joined, the territory or accounts I owned and the numbers that followed.
experience.empty: No roles have been added yet.

skills.title: Skills & methods
skills.description: Sales skills grouped by area: prospecting, discovery and closing, account management, forecasting and tools.
skills.heading: How I sell
skills.lead: Grouped by area: the methods, habits and tools I rely on.
skills.empty: No skills have been added yet.

certifications.title: Training & awards
certifications.description: Training, courses, awards and certifications: earned, in progress and planned.
certifications.heading: Training, awards & certifications
certifications.lead: Recognition received and the training that keeps the craft sharp.
certifications.emptyBody: Add training, awards or certifications you would like to show.

blog.title: Insights
blog.description: Notes on selling, negotiation and building relationships.
blog.heading: Notes on selling
blog.lead: What I am learning about buyers, pipeline and winning trust.

talks.title: Talks
talks.heading: Talks & workshops
talks.empty: No talks listed yet. Check back soon.

contact.heading: Looking for a closer? Let us talk.
contact.lead: The best ways to reach me about sales roles, partnerships or growing a territory.
